title: White Sesame and Pistachio Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Toasted white sesame blended into the dairy, with orange zest, less vanilla, pistachios and a pomegranate molasses drizzle.
summary: Built on our classic custard method, this one has freshly toasted sesame seeds blended into the dairy and less vanilla, with orange zest and pistachios. A drizzle of pomegranate molasses on top gives it a tangy finish.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Toast the sesame
steps.text: Toast the sesame seeds in the small frying pan over medium heat, shaking often, until golden and fragrant, 3-4 min. Freshly toasted seeds give much more flavour than pre-toasted ones.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blitz the warm seeds for 10 s, pour in half the milk and blend to a fine paste, then add the rest of the milk and all the cream and blend on high for 30 s.

steps.title: Make the custard
steps.text: Beat the yolks and sugar in the saucepan until pale, then whisk in the sesame dairy.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Stir over medium-low heat to 77-80 °C, when the custard coats the spatula.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Sieve into a bowl, pressing hard on the sesame pulp to get every bit of liquid out.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Stir in the orange zest, vanilla and salt, cool over the iced water and refrigerate for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn until thick, adding the chilled pistachios during the last minute, then freeze for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scoop into bowls and drizzle about 1 tsp of pomegranate molasses over each portion.

tips: Chill the toasted pistachios in the freezer so they stay crunchy in the ice cream.
A common mistake is letting the sesame seeds darken too far; they turn bitter quickly once golden.
Pomegranate molasses is sharp; taste a little before you drizzle.
storage: Freeze in a covered container for up to 2 weeks. Add the pomegranate molasses only when serving.
